preconditions.description: The dimensions of the picture and the number of copies are within the specified bounds.
The number of pictures matches the number of copies plus the initial picture.

preconditions.expression: all(len(picture) == n for picture in pictures)
preconditions.description: Each picture has the correct number of rows.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for picture in pictures for row in picture)
preconditions.description: Each row in the pictures has the correct number of columns.

preconditions.expression: all(all(cell in {'0', '1'} for cell in row) for picture in pictures for row in picture)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the pictures is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The index of the initial picture is within the valid range.
The number of operations is within the valid range.
The number of operations matches the specified count.

postconditions.expression: all(operation[0] in {'1', '2'} for operation in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation is of type '1' or '2'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(operation[1]) <= k + 1 for operation in operations if operation[0] == '2')
postconditions.description: The index in copy operations is within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(operation[1]) <= n - 1 and 2 <= int(operation[2]) <= m - 1 for operation in operations if operation[0] == '1')
postconditions.description: The coordinates in recolor operations are within the valid range and not on the border.

postconditions.expression: all(all(i in set(range(1, k + 2)) for i in [initial_index] + [int(operation[1]) for operation in operations if operation[0] == '2']))
postconditions.description: Each index from 1 to k+1 appears exactly once in the output.
